source.publisher: NHS England, A&E Attendances and Emergency Admissions statistical work area
source.requests_note: 102 monthly provider-level CSV GETs plus 12 year-page GETs to enumerate the URLs; measured 5.9 s wall clock on the coordinator (1.9 GiB class host) for the v2026.12 rebuild c (the v2026.11 fetch of the same 114 requests measured 1.0 s)
source.fetch_provenance: v2026.12 rebuild c fetched over HTTP on the coordinator (composite sha256 identical to the 15:26 v2026.12 build and to v2026.11 - the source snapshot did not move on 2026-10-21). The publisher's CDN (CloudFront) serves HTTP 202 with an empty body to datacenter IPs (measured 2026-10-21 on worker job nhsae-001), so a worker cannot fetch this publisher; the v2026.10 build consumed the same bytes from staging release source-nhsae-001 (asset 661561799, sha256 8d8bc1b1..., verified per-file by build.py)

label.within4h_rate: 1 - Attendances over 4hrs Type 1 / A&E attendances Type 1
label.note: fixed thresholds measured near-uniform rates and were refused (record: <95% -> holdout 99.9% positive; <80% -> 95.8%); the m/m direction label is threshold-free

volume_gate.applies_to: the provider's qualifying months at or before M; the target month M+1 supplies only the label

measurements.revision_policy: duplicate (org, month) keys keep the copy from the latest upload, ordered by (revision datestamp in filename, revised flag, filename); originals without a datestamp sort before every revision

gate.note: eligibility is decided at M only: the provider has 24 volume-qualified months at or before M and month M qualifies; the target month supplies the label and never decides whether a row exists (a missing target month is counted as unobserved_target - missing outcome data, not exclusion)

measurements.clustered_events_note: distinct_events counts distinct positive Org Codes per window - positives cluster within providers, so this is the conservative independent-unit count
measurements.schema_evolution: 16 data columns 2018-04..2020-07 (with 'Number of' prefixes in 2018-19); booked-appointment columns from 2020-08 (22 columns); unnamed padding columns from 2024-09 (28 header fields); booked columns parsed but not shipped - they are absent for train feature months 2018-12..2020-07, so shipping them would be a split-dependent prediction-timing defect

reference_baselines.note: stdlib rank AUC measured at construction on the written rows; every score is a prediction-time-safe single feature

runner_contract_baseline.note: measured via baseline/reproduce_baseline.sh on the v2026.12 rebuild c public splits, coordinator (python 3.14.7, pandas 2.3.3, numpy 2.5.4, xgboost 3.4.1, scikit-learn 1.9.1), after gate 1.4.0 passed on the full artifact; below every eval reference (target-month prior 0.6027, reversal 0.5839, persistence 0.5758, mean reversion 0.5659). The v2026.10 worker baseline nhsae-baseline-001 (0.5526 on superseded artifact 9903df974f233dfa) is preserved in the candidate record and in staging release 419227918.

artifact.name: nhs-ae-four-hour-decline
artifact.label_rule: declines = 1 iff within4h_rate(M+1) < within4h_rate(M), within4h_rate(Y) = 1 - Attendances over 4hrs Type 1 / A&E attendances Type 1; a row for feature month M requires >= 100 Type 1 attendances in M and 24 such volume-qualified months at or before M (the target month supplies the label only; a missing target month is unobserved outcome data, not exclusion)
